title: 第13章 爷爷的遗言第14章 坐地起价成功
slug: 无敌镖人开局护送灭世帝女
lines: 苏月眼疾手快，一把将洛璃拉回座位上，板起脸来低声喝道。
“小璃，不可胡闹！”
洛璃款款落座，忍不住又看了看门外。
她虽然任性，但并非不讲道理，更不是一个没有眼界的人。
这一路的表现，足以证明他爷爷的话……以这个家伙的能力，确实可以将她护送至大周。
而且才一百二十两，这也算是捡了一个天大的便宜。
可，这个钻到钱眼里的家伙，不近人情就算了，说话还句句带着毒。
这是要陪伴自己一路去大周，搞不好真要被他直接气死在半道上！
“小姨，可是我……”
苏月知道她要说什么，当即抬手轻轻拍了拍她的手背，打断了她的话。
“小璃，无论你到底有没有被拉入‘莫回头’的规则，单凭他这一路的表现，以及能安然无恙地在深夜将你带进望月城，这就足以证明他的实力。”
“一匹黑马而已，就算了，接下来的路途遥远，你确实需要这样一个人护你周全。”
“就算你不相信别人，也要相信你爷爷的眼光。”
提到爷爷，洛璃激荡的情绪又渐渐冷静了下来。
因为她忽然想起，前日从小河村返回家时，爷爷路上说过一句话。
“你这一路，你若碰到贪财之人，那人便不会负你；你若碰到冷漠之人，才能随他进入大周……切记，若不满足这两点，万万不可入大周。”
她至今仍无法理解爷爷这句话，但这两点却同时在陈观身上出现了！
“为什么只有满足这两点之人，才能护我入大周？”
洛璃满心疑惑，沉默片刻，最终她还是选择坚信爷爷的提示，点头道。
苏月欣慰的点了点头。
这丫头她从小看着长大，但因身世缘故，导致性子孤傲，很少能看到她任性。
能将她气成这样，看来她这是碰到对手了。
苏月笑道：“好了好了，不说他了。”
紧接着她岔开话题问道，“你爷爷呢？他身子骨可还好？”
“我爷爷……”
洛璃刚想说出爷爷已经过世，可话到嘴边，耳边响起了爷爷临终前的郑重叮嘱。
“小璃，记住，我过世的消息，除了那位陈镖师，你绝对不可告诉任何人！”
“包括你小姨，你舅舅，以及任何你认为可以信赖之人。”
“切记，你现在唯一能相信的人，便是陈镖师。
你就当这是我……唯一的遗言，切记……切记……”
这是爷爷的嘱托，也是他最后的遗言。

With quick eyes and quick hands, Su Yue pulled Luo Li back to her seat, and shouted in a low voice with a straight face.
"Xiao Li, don't mess around!"
"Me!"
Luo Li sat down and couldn't help but look outside the door again.
Although she is willful, she is not unreasonable, nor is she a person without vision.
The performance along the way was enough to prove his grandfather's words... with this guy's ability, he could indeed escort her to Dazhou.
And it was only one hundred and twenty taels, which was a huge bargain.
However, this guy who got into Qian's eyes is just unkind, and everything he says is poisonous.
This is to accompany him all the way to Dazhou. Maybe he will be pissed to death on the way!
"Auntie, but I..."
Su Yue knew what she was going to say, so she immediately raised her hand and patted the back of her hand gently, interrupting her words.
"Xiao Li, regardless of whether you have been dragged into the 'no turning back' rule or not, his performance along the way and the fact that he can bring you into Wangyue City safely and soundly in the middle of the night are enough to prove his strength."
"It's just a dark horse. Forget it. The road ahead is long and you really need someone like this to protect you."
"Even if you don't trust others, you still have to trust your grandpa's vision."
At the mention of grandpa, Luo Li's turbulent emotions gradually calmed down.
Because she suddenly remembered that when she returned home from Xiaohe Village the day before yesterday, her grandfather said something on the way.
"On your journey, if you meet someone who is greedy for money, that person will not betray you; if you meet someone who is indifferent, then you can follow him into the Great Zhou... Remember, if you do not meet these two points, you must not enter the Great Zhou."
She still can't understand her grandfather's words, but these two points appeared in Chen Guan at the same time!
"Why can only those who meet these two points protect me when I enter the Great Zhou Dynasty?"
Luo Li was filled with doubts and was silent for a moment. In the end, she chose to believe in her grandfather's reminder and nodded.
"Okay!"
Su Yue nodded happily.
She had watched this girl grow up, but due to her life experience, she had an aloof temper and it was rare to see her willful.
To be able to make her so angry, it seems that she has met her match.
Su Yue smiled and said: "Okay, okay, let's not talk about him anymore."
Then she changed the subject and asked, "Where is your grandfather? Is he in good health?"
"My grandfather..."
Luo Li was just about to say that her grandfather had passed away, but as she spoke, her grandfather's solemn instructions before his death rang in his ears.
"Xiao Li, remember, you must not tell anyone about my death except escort Chen!"
"Including your aunt, your uncle, and anyone you think you can trust."
"Remember, the only person you can trust now is escort Chen.
Just think of this as my...only last words, remember...remember..."
This was Grandpa's request and his last words.
